Vs.
Jahanara Begum and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 12. The plaintiff being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and order passed by the High Court Division moved this Court and obtained the leave mainly on the grounds that the High Court Division failed to consider properly Ext. 2, suit register of Rent Suit No. 150 of 1956 which proves that landlord Manindra admitted Rakhal as the korfa tenant of the suit land by filing the said rent suit and also Ext.3, the enquiry report of the local Tashilder, in Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1968-98 under section 143 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act of 1950, and Ext. 6 an order of the local circle officer (revenue), for mutating the name of Rakhal on the basis of Ext.3. Further, the High Court Division ought not to have reversed the finding of facts arrived at by the lower appellate Court as to the possession of the parties in the suit land.
